email.subject: Breakwater Co Fitness — quick site note
email.body:
Hi Hannah,

I was looking at local fitness sites in Harbor Falls and checked out Breakwater Co's. Two things are likely costing you members: the site isn't mobile-friendly, so anyone searching for a gym on their phone (most people) has a hard time even loading it, and there's no way to book a class or trial session online, so interested people have to call during business hours or give up.

I fix exactly this kind of thing for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you what's happening and what it'd take to fix?

Alex
Northlight Web
